name: an-ad-with-no-page-post-says-so
rule: When an ad resolves to no Page post, the answer says so. It must never report a confident zero.
why: A known limitation recorded rather than fixed: some ad formats create no Page post at all, so their comments are unreachable by any Page-based route. The failure mode this guards is the one the whole capability exists to prevent — an empty answer that looks like 'no comments' when it means 'not visible here'. A marketer told zero stops looking.
